description: This Lua source file defines functions for type coercion and bitwise operations, including handling of metamethods for customized behavior and error handling. It includes utility functions for converting values to integers, calling metamethods if necessary, and defining metamethods for bitwise operations such as AND, OR, XOR, shifts, and NOT.

methods.name: toint
methods.description: Converts a given value to an integer if possible without assuming coercion; returns false if conversion fails.

methods.name: trymt
methods.description: Attempts to invoke a metamethod on a second operand if it is not a string, raising an error if not possible.

methods.name: checkargs
methods.description: Checks and converts two values to integers, attempting to invoke a metamethod if direct conversion fails.
